• BackstoryTemplate_1Cloned Hemo-SackCloned Hemo-Sack[PAWN_nameDef] is an artifcial human created in a Mechanoid cloning facility as a roundabout fuel supply. When new Hives first emerge, Hemo-sacks are deployed alongside Mechanoid forces to act as a natural fuel source, turning otherwise useless organic substances into extractable hemogen, which in turn can be used to power Mechanoid facilities. They are often discarded when the Hives are more well established. Due to the rapid nature of the cloning process, the Hemo-Sacks are left mentally underdeveloped, and rarely operate at a capacity more than simple basic instinct.
